title: Remove splash screen and load app directly into Login/Dashboard

requirements.text: Completely remove the splash screen from the codebase by deleting `frontend/src/components/system/InitialLoadSplash.tsx` and removing all imports/usages/references to it across the app.

quotes:
Completely delete the splash screen from the web app.
The app should load directly into the main screen without any splash screen.
There must be no SplashScreen component in the project.

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/components/system/InitialLoadSplash.tsx` no longer exists in the repository.
The project compiles with no references/imports of `InitialLoadSplash` (or any splash/splash-screen component) remaining.
No splash UI (logo/dots/overlay) is rendered at any point during app startup.

requirements.text: Remove any splash-related conditional render logic and any artificial initialization delays so the app renders the real first screen immediately (Login when logged out; Dashboard when logged in). Specifically remove the `isInitializing` state and the startup `setTimeout` delay currently gating the app UI in `frontend/src/App.tsx`.

quotes:
App should load directly into:
Dashboard (if logged in)
Login screen (if not logged in)
No intermediate splash screen should appear.

acceptanceCriteria: On refresh, the app does not wait on any fixed timer before rendering Login/Dashboard.
When `state.userProfile` is absent, the first rendered screen is the Login page without an intermediate splash.
When `state.userProfile` is present, the first rendered screen is the Home/Dashboard without an intermediate splash.

requirements.text: Remove any initial loading/splash markup from the HTML entrypoint and public assets (e.g., any `#splash-screen` div, hardcoded loading spinner markup, or similar placeholders) so the only startup container is the React root.

quotes:
Check and remove from:
index.html
public folder
root div loading markup
Any hardcoded loading spinner or splash div

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/index.html` contains only the React root container and no splash/loading placeholder elements (e.g., no `id="splash-screen"`).
No public/static HTML assets include splash/loading markup that is displayed before React renders.

requirements.text: Remove any splash-specific styling (CSS classes, inline styles, animations) so no leftover splash styles affect the app; keep a clean, solid dark initial background to avoid any pre-render background flash.

quotes:
Delete:
Splash screen CSS
Splash-related background colors
Inline loading styles
Purple/pink background styles
Any animation tied to splash
Ensure no leftover CSS affects body background.

✔ No background flash
✔ Clean dark theme background

acceptanceCriteria: No CSS/animation is retained solely for splash rendering (e.g., bounce-dot loading indicators) after the splash component is removed.
On hard refresh, the document background remains a solid dark color before React mounts (no purple/pink flash).
Removing the splash does not change the normal in-app theming behavior after the app mounts.

requirements.text: If the project includes any Service Worker / PWA precache behavior, update it so splash-related cached assets and any cached HTML that could reintroduce splash UI are not served; ensure the newest version loads immediately after deployment.

quotes:
Remove Service Worker Cache (If Exists)

If splash screen is cached:
Clear service worker cache
Remove cached splash assets
Ensure new version loads immediately

acceptanceCriteria: If a Service Worker exists in the project, it does not cache or serve any splash-screen-related assets or HTML that would recreate a splash UI.
After a deployment, a normal reload shows the updated app (no stale splash artifacts).
If no Service Worker exists, there are no code references attempting to register one.

constraints: Do not hide the splash screen via CSS (e.g., `display:none`)—the splash component, logic, and assets must be removed from the project.
Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)`, or `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts` (immutable paths).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not change core attendance logic, ranking logic, persistence/backup formats, or notification behavior beyond removing splash-related UI and caching artifacts.
Do not redesign the app UI theme; only remove splash-related UI/logic and prevent pre-render flashing.
